name: deband
what: smooths the visible steps in gradients (ffmpeg gradfun) and leaves edges alone
when: skies, fades or soft shadows show stepped bands instead of a smooth gradient
tried_on: written from restoration practice; runs and passes the guard on a 15 s cut of an owner cartoon that does not show this defect (safe to try). Whether it helps on a source that has the defect is not shown yet
